item.title: What if AI doesn't need more RAM but better math?
Solar is winning the energy race
item.description:
📝 Data from Taipei-based LowCarbonPower shows that 11% of China's electricity now comes from solar energy. In the EU, solar energy covers roughly 13% of the bloc's electricity demand. And solar is getting ever cheaper.
🔗 Read more: https://www.dw.com/en/solar-is-winning-the-energy-race/a-76517556
